name: Freeze evidence and scope
action: Hash current GSS registry/code/accepted outputs; lock 35 active waves; exclude Asian W6; declare V550/V551/V552 frozen.
gate: No authority production until baseline and source precedence are explicit.

name: Map downstream information needs
action: Trace what V552J, V553+, mediation and runtime gates can consume; list respondent-level ambiguities that isolated V551 atoms cannot resolve.
gate: Every later family concept must name a real consumer and ambiguity resolved.

name: Build governed question-node catalog
action: Create active-35-wave nodes from canonical identity, original source/codebook, accepted question authority and response-scale authority. Attach QSM/semantic indices as discovery annotations only.
gate: Every node has source identity, response authority and evidence ceiling or explicit unresolved status.

name: Define typed collision templates
action: Formalize semantic relations capable of generating compositional candidates and route non-J interactions to later stages.
gate: No free-form pair generation; each candidate cites one or more governed templates.

name: Generate candidate graph
action: Use source-native structures, semantic blocking rules, downstream ambiguity searches and optional recall aids to generate typed edges/hyperedges without O(n²) enumeration.

name: Run ownership and admissibility gates
action: Test pipeline ownership, semantic composition, incremental information, respondent compatibility, response authority, stability and evidence ceiling.
output: Admissible J-family candidate classes plus routed/rejected candidates.

name: Prioritize concept classes
action: Rank collision classes using information gain, source validity, coverage, portability, downstream leverage and profile discrimination divided by complexity/uncertainty.
gate: Priority is not authority; low-tier items remain preserved for completeness review.

name: Adjudicate family concepts across sources
action: For one high-value concept, review all implementations across all relevant GSS and non-GSS waves and countries; define universal core and narrower variants.
output: Canonical family-concept ruling and implementation inventory.
gate: No one-wave or smoke-country scoping unless source evidence requires it.

name: Author canonical authority
action: Create concept, implementation and pattern-semantics objects with provenance, completeness, routing, evidence ceiling, prohibited claims and synthetic tests.
gate: No executable projection until source completeness and tests pass.

name: Complete residual census
action: Review all source-native structures and unclassified collision edges so priority-led work does not omit unusual high-value families.
gate: Every investigated structure has approved, rejected, routed, deferred or source-gap disposition.

name: Assess runtime contract once
action: Compare the complete canonical requirements universe against current V550J/V551J. Separate metadata gaps from true execution gaps.
output: Shared GSS/non-GSS contract-gap census and one architecture decision.

name: Backfill GSS and non-GSS authority
action: Represent all valid GSS and non-GSS families in the same canonical architecture; generate exact instrument implementations.
gate: Existing GSS results preserved unless an explicitly approved semantic correction requires migration.

name: Project and execute later
action: Generate runtime registries, run V550J/V551J, prove GSS invariance and then feed V552J against unchanged V552.
gate: Separate work order after authority approval.
